excluded_from_shared_panel.cyclohexanone: no unambiguous single at-Tb dHvap datum in the NIST/Majer-Svoboda compilation (only a value corrected to 298.15 K and a mid-range value); admitting it would break the consistent at-Tb truth basis. Also a known cyclic-ketone Joback outlier (first-order groups miss the cyclic C=O association).

honest_limitations: dHvap here is the latent heat at the NORMAL BOILING POINT (Joback's basis). To obtain the cohesive energy / Hildebrand delta at 25 C a Watson-type temperature correction (needs Tc) is required; that extension is deliberately NOT graded here to keep the truth basis single-source and the KPI non-circular.

hydrogen-bonding alcohols (methanol/ethanol/propanols/butanol) are boundary/out: Joback first-order groups systematically under-predict dHvap by ~2-6% because O-H association energy is not additive at first order (see kpis.associating_set_*).
cyclohexanone is excluded from the panel: no unambiguous single at-Tb NIST datum (only 298 K-corrected / mid-range), and it is a known cyclic-ketone Joback outlier.

isomers with identical first-order group multisets (o- vs p-xylene) receive an identical prediction; Joback first order cannot resolve positional isomerism (both are nonetheless within ~2% of their distinct experimental dHvap).
pure-component latent heat at 1 atm; a real solvent BLEND evaporates non-ideally (activity coefficients) -- a Phase-1 extension, not claimed here.

kpis.cohesive_energy_link_note: ecoh_Tb = dHvap(Tb) - R*Tb is reported per solvent as the self-contained cohesive-energy consequence of this anchor; delta_Hildebrand = sqrt(E_coh/V) then follows (V = M/rho, in panel). This is the INDEPENDENT (Joback) route to the cohesive energy that the Fedors delta anchor estimates a different way -> cross-method check. Reported as supporting evidence; the GRADED KPI is the direct dHvap(Tb) prediction only.
kpis.core_domain_definition: aromatic, aliphatic, cyclic, ketone (acyclic), ester chemistries; excludes hydrogen-bonding alcohols (declared boundary/out a priori) and cyclohexanone (excluded from the panel for at-Tb truth-basis consistency)
kpis.systematic_bias_note: Joback first-order dHvap systematically UNDER-predicts for hydrogen-bonding alcohols (mean signed error is negative) because O-H...O association energy is not in a first-order group sum; reported, not corrected (a fitted correction would break non-circularity).

phase0_reconciliation_redteam.honest_reading: PHASE_0 here = a reproducibility+rights+independence GOVERNANCE lock, NOT scientific validation. Live cross-check of every phase0 promotion policy: scientific_success_required is FALSE in 100% of them, and no policy targets scientific_readiness=VALIDATED (ceiling is LOCKED_INTERNAL). NOT_APPLICABLE-readiness modules are governance/infrastructure; LOCKED_INTERNAL modules passed an INTERNAL known-answer only. ZERO modules carry scientific_readiness=VALIDATED. Exactly ONE module (amphora-solvency-score) has any EXTERNAL-data predictive validation behind it. 'FULL Phase-0' is an engineering/governance milestone, never a count of validated coating science. This audit does NOT change that count.

rights.ground_truth_data: NIST Chemistry WebBook / Majer & Svoboda 1985 -- U.S. Government work host, public-domain critical data
rights.in_scope: marine two-part epoxy-amine coating thinner / co-solvent chemistries (xylenes, MEK, MIBK, n-butyl acetate, n-butanol, IPA, ...); no adjacent-industry data
rights.physical_constants: M, rho, Tb are tabulated CRC/NIST facts (non-copyrightable)
rights.predictor_method: Joback group contribution -- published theory, freely usable

target_capability: a-priori enthalpy of vaporization dHvap(Tb) for coating solvents/reactive diluents -- the thermodynamic driver linking the anchored VOLATILITY axis (Clausius-Clapeyron vapour pressure / flash-off) and the anchored SOLUBILITY axis (cohesive energy E_coh=dHvap-RT -> Hildebrand/Hansen delta feeding amphora-solvency-score), via an independent third group-contribution method

theory.ground_truth: NIST Chemistry WebBook experimental enthalpies of vaporization measured AT the normal boiling point, Majer & Svoboda 1985 critical compilation (public domain); one consistent at-Tb basis
theory.non_circularity: Joback hvk_i are universal published constants NOT fitted to this panel; ground-truth dHvap are independent experimental measurements. No parameter is tuned on the validation set.
theory.operational_kpi: point accuracy (MAPE) of dHvap(Tb) plus Spearman rank order (cohesive-energy / volatility ordering a blend is designed on)
theory.predictor: Joback & Reid 1987 first-order group contribution: dHvap(Tb) = 15.30 kJ/mol + sum_i n_i hvk_i
theory.predictor_citation: Joback & Reid, Chem. Eng. Commun. 1987, 57, 233; Poling/Prausnitz/O'Connell, Properties of Gases and Liquids 5th ed., Table C-1
theory.trust_guard: every hand-encoded Joback group multiset is formula-checked against RDKit (C,H,O) -- a miscount cannot pass; group encoding is byte-identical to the boiling-point audit for shared solvents

verdict.authority: AUDIT_ONLY -- graded domain-of-applicability study, NOT a Phase-0 gate
verdict.gate_logic: core_dhvap_MAPE<=2.5% AND 100% within +-5% AND lift>=60% AND spearman(core order)>=0.95 (conservative: gated on the CORE non-associating set only, excluding alcohols)
